title: Draft: QUIC: Add Support for Address Discovery
description: Support dissecting the QUIC OBSERVED_ADDRESS frame and associated address_discovery transport parameter.

notes.body:
I understand that this is a little premature, but the draft will be on the agenda at the next IETF meeting and I just wanted to get your feedback. 

As always, thank you for all the work that you do maintaining Wireshark!
Hi will, i have already a draft MR (waiting Address Discovery coming on IETF Draft) #17984

Well, nuts! I was _really_ hoping I could help! The good news is that it looks like you and I had almost identical implementation. 

I will close this in favor of yours, of course. 

As always, thank you!

Will
